'Frick rejected Wolfsburg before joining Aberdeen' - gossip
- Published
Mario Frick reportedly rejected the Wolfsburg job before becoming Aberdeen's new head coach, while Celtic are said to have no plans to sell in-form Mika Baur.
New Aberdeen head coach Mario Frick had been offered the Wolfsburg job and also turned down opportunities in Italy and France after leaving Luzern this summer. (Sky Sports, external)
Former Rangers manager Ally McCoist has refused to close the door on management despite enjoying his time in punditry. (The National, external)
Mikey Moore reckons the criticism he faced early on in his Rangers loan spell helped toughen him up mentally for his return to Tottenham Hotspur and the 19-year-old winger's current loan to Cologne. (Daily Record, external)
Alex Valle has credited his time at Celtic with helping to shape his career despite the 22-year-old left-back cutting short his loan from Barcelona in 2025 to join Como. (Marca via Glasgow Times, external)
Celtic are not considering the sale of midfielder Mika Baur as a possibility in the January transfer window so soon after the 22-year-old's summer move from Paderborn, despite the German attracting interest. (Football Insider, external)

St Johnstone chairman Adam Webb says the Perth club were powerless to stop their star player, winger Josh McPake, agreeing a pre-contract with Heart of Midlothian and then leaving on a free transfer in the summer. (The Courier, external)
Former Rangers defender Calvin Bassey, the 26-year-old currently with Fulham, has been identified as one of new Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino's key targets in the January transfer window. (The Telegraph, external)
Ross Taylor has revealed that he worked in Morrisons supermarket after being offloaded by Rangers, St Mirren and Greenock Morton before the midfielder resurrected his career with Stenhousemuir and now Ayr United. (Sunday Mail, external)
Rangers' owners, 49ers Enterprises, have drafted in a secretive New York investment bank to value Leeds United and test the waters for fresh billionaire backing for their Premier League club. (Scottish Sun, external)

מאמן אברדין החדש, מריו פריק, דחה הצעה לאמן את וולפסבורג וכן סירב להזדמנויות נוספות בצרפת ובאיטליה לאחר שעזב את לוצרן בקיץ. מנגד, סלטיק הבהירה כי אינה שוקלת את מכירתו של הקשר מיקה באור בחלון ההעברות של חודש ינואר, זאת זמן קצר בלבד לאחר שהוחתם מפארדרבורן. 

בגזרות נוספות בכדורגל הבריטי, קלווין באסי מפולהאם סומן על ידי מנג'ר מנצ'סטר יונייטד, מאוריסיו פוצ'טינו,אחד מהיעדים המרכזיים בחלון ההעברות הקרוב. כמו כן, בעלי ריינג'רס שכרו בנק השקעות מניו יורק כדי להעריך את שוויו של מועדון לידס יונייטד ולבחון אפשרות לגיוס משקיעים חדשים עבור קבוצת הפרמייר ליג.
